**7B.8 Research Note: Joko Widodo in 2024**

Overall read: **mixed, leaning negative**. Jokowi did respect some formal commitments at the end of his term, but the stronger 2024 pattern is opportunistic political maneuvering, selective candor, and manipulation of the information environment around succession and family advantage.

**Positive / mitigating evidence**
- **President Jokowi calls on president, VP-elect to work immediately after inauguration** | Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia | 2024-04-24 | https://setkab.go.id/en/president-jokowi-calls-on-president-vp-elect-to-work-immediately-after-inauguration/ | Jokowi said the Constitutional Court process was almost complete, the decision must be respected as final and binding, and the cabinet would help a smooth transition. This is direct evidence of respecting formal succession commitments. | `7B.8` `7B.6`
- **Indonesia court rejects election disputes, upholding Prabowo’s win** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-04-22 | https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-court-rejects-election-challenges-upholds-president-elect-prabowos-win/2051948/ | The court said there was no evidence of systematic fraud or presidential meddling. That is limited positive evidence that the election outcome and legal process were allowed to stand. | `7B.8` `4B.2`
- **Farewell welcome ceremony for Indonesia’s president from Jokowi to Prabowo Subianto** | Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia | 2024-10-20 | https://setkab.go.id/en/farewell-welcome-ceremony-for-indonesias-president-from-jokowi-to-prabowo-subianto/ | Jokowi completed the scheduled constitutional handover on inauguration day. This is the strongest formal-compliance evidence in 2024. | `7B.8` `4B.2`
- **President Jokowi says “I am not perfect”** | Presidency of Indonesia | 2024-08-01 | https://presidenri.go.id/siaran-pers/presiden-jokowi-saya-tidak-sempurna-saya-manusia-biasa/ | Jokowi publicly apologized for mistakes and shortcomings in office. That is direct evidence of admitting error rather than always doubling down. | `7B.8`
- **President urges BPKP to audit national data center governance** | ANTARA News | 2024-06-28 | https://en.antaranews.com/news/317175/president-urges-bpkp-to-audit-national-data-center-governance | After a ransomware attack, Jokowi ordered an audit of government data-center governance. This supports a limited “corrective disclosure” reading rather than automatic concealment. | `7B.8` `7B.7`
- **Jokowi minta perlunya mitigasi soal kebocoran data NPWP** | ANTARA News | 2024-09-19 | https://www.antaranews.com/berita/4345027/presiden-jokowi-minta-perlunya-mitigasi-soal-kebocoran-data-npwp | He ordered rapid mitigation after the alleged taxpayer-data breach. That is another narrow sign of responsiveness when a public failure surfaced. | `7B.8` `7B.7`

**Negative evidence**
- **Indonesia leader accused of bias, interference in presidential election** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-02-01 | https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-leader-accused-of-bias-interference-in-presidential-election/1948656/ | Reuters reported criticism of Jokowi’s apparent non-neutrality, including visible alignment with Prabowo while his son was on the ticket. This is strong negative evidence for clean candor and non-self-serving public posture. | `7B.8` `4B.2`
- **Indonesia shelves plan to revise election law as protests rage** | Reuters | 2024-08-22 | https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-shelves-plan-revise-election-law-protests-rage-2024-08-22/ | The proposed rule changes were widely seen as benefiting Jokowi’s youngest son and consolidating family advantage. That is strong evidence of opportunistic rule-bending for personal/family benefit. | `7B.8` `4B.2`
- **Poll shows Jokowi’s approval rating falls after protests, but still popular** | Reuters via The Jakarta Post | 2024-10-05 | https://www.thejakartapost.com/indonesia/2024/10/05/poll-shows-jokowis-approval-rating-falls-after-protests-but-still-popular | Allies’ August election-rule push would have helped Jokowi’s youngest son and triggered backlash. This supports a negative reading of selective transparency and family-advantage politics. | `7B.8` `4B.2`
- **Outgoing Indonesian president gives cabinet jobs to loyalists of successor Prabowo** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-08-19 | https://theprint.in/world/outgoing-indonesian-president-gives-cabinet-jobs-to-loyalists-of-successor-prabowo/2228867/ | Jokowi appointed people close to Prabowo into cabinet roles while framing the move as transition-smoothing. Reuters’ framing makes this look like strategic patronage rather than clean public explanation. | `7B.8` `7B.7`
- **Analysis: A decade of Jokowi leaves illiberal legacy, critics say** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-10-14 | https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/ | Reuters says Jokowi left patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity. For this lens, that is broad negative background for concealment of tradeoffs and self-protective political management. | `7B.8` `7B.7` `7B.6`
- **Indonesia: Freedom on the Net 2024** | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024 | Freedom House says direct content-restriction powers existed without appeals, critics and journalists faced prosecution/harassment, and disinformation and self-censorship were widespread. This is strong evidence of manipulation of public information and pressure on truth-tellers. | `7B.8` `7B.7` `7B.6`
- **Indonesia: Freedom in the World 2024** | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-world/2024 | The press environment remained constrained; journalists faced arrest, harassment, violence, and threats. That undercuts any claim of a consistently truth-first public information posture. | `7B.8` `7B.7` `7B.6`
- **Jokowi effect: how Indonesia’s outgoing leader shaped election to succeed him** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-02-12 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/jokowi-effect-how-indonesias-outgoing-leader-shaped-election-to-succeed-him-3300317/ | Reuters described Jokowi’s political weight shifting coalition behavior around the succession race. This is indirect but still negative evidence for clean separation between public duty and personal/family advantage. | `7B.8` `4B.2`

**Search gap**
- I did **not** find a clean 2024 source showing Jokowi explicitly reversing a named policy promise in a single, documentable “broken promise” episode.
- The strongest evidence is instead **pattern-based**: succession-rule maneuvering, family-advantage politics, and information control.
- I also did **not** find a direct 2024 instance of Jokowi personally issuing a falsified public explanation about one specific scandal; the concealment evidence is mostly indirect through media restrictions and patronage behavior.
